1.text: Uwiteka, Mana yo guhōra inzigo,Mana yo guhōra inzigo, rabagirana.

2.text: Wa mucamanza w'abari mu isi we, wishyire hejuru,Witure abibone ibibakwiriye.

3.text: Uwiteka, abanyabyaha bazageza he,Abanyabyaha bazageza he kwishima?

4.text: Badudubiranya amagambo bavuga iby'agasuzuguro.Inkozi z'ibibi zose zirirarira.

5.text: Uwiteka, bamenagura ubwoko bwawe,Bababaza umwandu wawe.

7.text: Bakavuga bati “Uwiteka ntari bubibone,Imana ya Yakobo ntiri bubyiteho.”

8.text: Mwa bameze nk'inka mwe bo mu bantu, mwite kuri ibi,Mwa bapfu mwe, muzagira ubwenge ryari?

10.text: Ihanisha amahanga ibihano ntizahana?Si yo yigisha abantu ubwenge?

11.text: Uwiteka azi ibyo abantu bibwira,Ko ari iby'ubusa gusa.

12.text: Uwiteka, hahirwa umuntu uhana,Ukamwigishisha amategeko yawe,

13.text: Kugira ngo umuruhure iminsi y'amakuba n'ibyago,Kugeza aho abanyabyaha bazacukurirwa ubushya,

14.text: Kuko Uwiteka atazata ubwoko bwe,Kandi atazareka umwandu we.

15.text: Kuko guca imanza kuzasubira ku kutabera,Kandi abafite imitima itunganye bose bazabishima.

16.text: Ni nde uzahaguruka akantabara kurwanya abanyabyaha?Ni nde uzahaguruka mu ruhande rwanjye kurwanya inkozi z'ibibi?

17.text: Iyo Uwiteka ataba umutabazi wanjye,Ubugingo bwanjye buba bwaratuye vuba ahacecekerwa.

18.text: Nkivuga nti “Ikirenge cyanjye kiranyereye”,Imbabazi zawe Uwiteka, zarandamiye.

19.text: Iyo ibyo nshidikanya byinshi bimpagaritse umutima,Ibyo umpumuriza byishimisha ubugingo bwanjye.

20.text: Mbese intebe y'abanyarugomo izafatanya nawe?Bagira amategeko urwitwazo rw'igomwa,

21.text: Bateranira gutera ubugingo bw'umukiranutsi,Bagaciraho iteka amaraso atariho urubanza.

22.text: Ariko Uwiteka ni igihome kirekire kinkingira,Imana yanjye ni igitare cy'ubuhungiro bwanjye.

23.text: Kandi izabagaruraho gukiranirwa kwabo,Izabarimburira mu byaha byabo,Uwiteka Imana yacu, izabarimbura.
